name: § 1, after point v – 68
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: va) make strategic use of all available instruments and financing under the current and next EU multiannual financial frameworks to create logistics gateways via the Black Sea and Central Asia that will enable European companies to better compete internationally and increase trade flows throughout the Middle Corridor; provide conditions to increase the competitiveness of European businesses and industry, which could decrease trade imbalances with China in strategic sectors;
